name: Vamana
description: Classical controlled elimination of accumulated Kapha toxins from the upper gastrointestinal tract and respiratory channels.

name: Virechana
description: Targeted elimination of excess Pitta toxins from the liver, gallbladder, small intestine, and blood vascular system.

name: Basti
description: The mother of all Panchakarma treatments. Delivers herbal oils and decoctions into the colon to pacify aggravated Vata.
benefits: Nourishes nervous system and brain tissue

name: Nasya
description: Administration of medicated herbal oils or powders through the nasal passages—the gateway to the brain and head region.
benefits: Strengthens neck and cervical nerve roots

name: Raktamokshana
description: Localized micro-purification of stagnant or vitiated blood tissue using traditional leech therapy (Jalaukavacharana) or cupping.
